'''The Asteroid Theater''' was a theatrical venue in [[Hologram Fun World]]. In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] visited the Asteroid Theater while vacationing at Hologram Fun World and saw a magic act performed by [[Bithabus]] the Mystifier. The performance was sold out for six months, but [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] used his influence to acquire tickets for the couple. During intermission, however, [[Zorba Desilijic Tiure]] attacked Bithabus and replaced him with [[Cobak]] the bounty hunter, who then selected Leia from the audience for his magic act and kidnapped her, taking her to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].
